# Button catalog

One searchable registry of every **distinct button** we drew or mapped for the games whose support is confirmed (6 games, 135 variants, 112 slots, 33 roles). Supporting the next game starts from the closest existing button instead of from zero.

- **Search:** `python3 tools/build_button_catalog.py find --role a --size 13x13 [--style ps|xbox] [--game <appid>] [--kind vector|mask|pixel|picture]` ranks the existing variants: exact size first, then the nearest by area and aspect, then the same style/kind, and says `drop-in` or `resize/restyle needed`.
- **Keep it in step:** after adding art or confirming a game run `python3 tools/build_button_catalog.py build`; `tests/test_button_catalog.py` fails until you do. Hand-maintained input: `catalog/sources.json`.
- **Originals are metadata only.** The catalog holds OUR art (files we own) and descriptions of each game's own buttons (size, role, look tags). It never holds game pixels (rule 13 of the safety invariants).
- A **variant** is one distinct art asset (identical pixels are one variant); a **slot** is one button position of a confirmed game. Machine-readable twin: [`catalog/catalog.json`](../catalog/catalog.json).

## Variants per role

Only distinct art is listed. `used by` names the confirmed games whose slots use it ("library" = in the icon library but no confirmed game uses it yet). Tags: style / shape / shading / label / colour / background.

## Roles

| Role | Meaning | Xbox | PlayStation | Variants | Slots |
|------|---------|------|-------------|----------|-------|
| `a` | bottom face button | A | cross | 9 | 15 |
| `b` | right face button | B | circle | 9 | 14 |
| `x` | left face button | X | square | 9 | 13 |
| `y` | top face button | Y | triangle | 9 | 13 |
| `lb` | left shoulder | LB | L1 | 7 | 6 |
| `rb` | right shoulder | RB | R1 | 7 | 6 |
| `lt` | left trigger | LT | L2 | 7 | 6 |
| `rt` | right trigger | RT | R2 | 7 | 6 |
| `l3` | left stick press | LS press | L3 | 8 | 2 |
| `r3` | right stick press | RS press | R3 | 8 | 2 |
| `lstick` | left stick (cap, ring or all directions) | LS | L | 5 | 2 |
| `lstick_neutral` | left stick at rest (one state of a directional set) | LS | L | 0 | 1 |
| `lstick_up` | left stick pushed up | LS up | L up | 1 | 1 |
| `lstick_down` | left stick pushed down | LS down | L down | 1 | 1 |
| `lstick_left` | left stick pushed left | LS left | L left | 1 | 1 |
| `lstick_right` | left stick pushed right | LS right | L right | 1 | 1 |
| `rstick` | right stick (cap, ring or all directions) | RS | R | 5 | 3 |
| `rstick_neutral` | right stick at rest (one state of a directional set) | RS | R | 0 | 0 |
| `rstick_up` | right stick pushed up | RS up | R up | 1 | 0 |
| `rstick_down` | right stick pushed down | RS down | R down | 1 | 0 |
| `rstick_left` | right stick pushed left | RS left | R left | 1 | 0 |
| `rstick_right` | right stick pushed right | RS right | R right | 1 | 0 |
| `dpad` | direction pad | D-pad | D-pad | 2 | 2 |
| `dpad_up` | direction pad, up | D-pad up | D-pad up | 4 | 2 |
| `dpad_down` | direction pad, down | D-pad down | D-pad down | 4 | 2 |
| `dpad_left` | direction pad, left | D-pad left | D-pad left | 4 | 2 |
| `dpad_right` | direction pad, right | D-pad right | D-pad right | 4 | 2 |
| `start` | right small button | Menu | OPTIONS | 5 | 4 |
| `select` | left small button | View / Back | SHARE | 3 | 3 |
| `home` | guide / PS button | Guide | PS | 3 | 0 |
| `touchpad` | touchpad | - | touchpad | 7 | 0 |
| `hold` | HOLD label | - | - | 0 | 1 |
| `controller` | whole controller picture (options screen) | Xbox pad | DualSense | 1 | 1 |

A game's own role names are aliases: `empty` = `b` (AC1 empty-hand glyph (B)); `head` = `y` (AC1 eagle-vision glyph (Y)); `legs` = `a` (AC1 legs glyph (A)); `ls` = `lstick` (AC1 / older name of the left stick); `options` = `start` (PlayStation name of start); `rs` = `rstick` (AC1 / older name of the right stick); `share` = `select` (PlayStation name of select); `weapon` = `x` (AC1 weapon-hand glyph (X)).

## Tag vocabulary

**style**

- `ps`: PlayStation look (cross circle square triangle, L1/R2, OPTIONS/SHARE)
- `xbox`: Xbox look (A B X Y, LB/RT, Menu/View)
- `neutral`: no console look (tinted by the profile, or a picture without buttons)

**shape**

- `disc`: round face button
- `pill`: small rounded rectangle (menu / start / select)
- `bumper`: shoulder button (curved or slanted pill, usually with a word)
- `trigger`: trigger (trapezoid or tall rectangle, usually with a word)
- `d-pad`: cross-shaped direction pad
- `stick-cap`: thumbstick (round cap, ring or press symbol)
- `arrow`: single arrow
- `text`: bare text without a button body
- `glyph`: bare symbol or label drawn onto the game's own shape (white-on-transparent mask)
- `rect`: plain rectangle (touchpad)
- `icon`: pictogram that is not a standard button (AC1 body-part glyphs)
- `picture`: whole controller drawing
- `unknown`: not recorded

**shading**

- `flat`: flat fill
- `outline`: outline only (ring or stroke)
- `jewel-3d`: glossy gem-like pixel shading (the game's own SFH tooltip buttons)
- `pixel-bevel`: hand-pixelled edge light/dark (bevel) and a 1 px outline
- `line-art`: line drawing
- `unknown`: not recorded

**label**

- `letter`: a single letter (A, B, X, Y, L, R)
- `symbol`: PlayStation symbol (cross, circle, square, triangle)
- `word`: a word or code (LB, L2, OPTIONS, START)
- `icon`: a drawn icon (menu lines, play arrow, share, body part)
- `none`: nothing printed
- `mixed`: varies by role
- `unknown`: not recorded

**background**

- `dark`: dark body or dark surface behind the glyph
- `light`: light body or light surface
- `transparent`: no body: transparent around the glyph
- `mixed`: several body colours in the same family (e.g. black, orange and grey-blue)
- `unknown`: not recorded

**colour**

- `xbox-colours`: A green, B red, X blue, Y yellow
- `ps-symbol-colours`: PlayStation symbol colours (region_glyphs.PS_COLORS): cross #6ea8fe, circle #ff4b4b, square #e67acb, triangle #34b899
- `mono-light`: one light colour
- `mono-dark`: one dark colour
- `mono-white-mask`: white mask, tinted by the profile when drawn
- `mixed`: several colours without a console scheme
- `unknown`: not recorded

**ps_action**

- `redraw`: new symbol drawn (cross circle square triangle, OPTIONS, SHARE, controller picture)
- `relabel`: new text drawn (LB becomes L1, RT becomes R2, L3)
- `same`: identical on a PlayStation pad: left alone
- `switch`: the game already ships a PlayStation version: the plugin only selects it, no art of ours

**kind**

- `vector`: SVG in assets/svg (rendered at any size)
- `mask`: white-on-transparent PNG tinted and fitted when drawn
- `pixel`: native-size RGBA PNG that replaces a whole tiny texture
- `picture`: whole-picture RGBA PNG placed in a box

## Origins and licences

- `figma-ps`: Figma community file 'PlayStation Controller Icons' (third-party set; the Sony marks are theirs; licence stated as open by the project owner, 2026-11-24; exact licence name not recorded), split into one SVG per icon by tools/split_svg_sheet.py
- `figma-xbox`: Figma community file 'Xbox Controller Icons Free' (third-party set; the Microsoft marks are theirs; licence stated as open by the project owner, 2026-11-24; exact licence name not recorded), split into one SVG per icon by tools/split_svg_sheet.py
- `our-drawing`: drawn by this project: PIL shapes rendered by tools/qb_build.py (render_masks)
- `montserrat-ofl`: label text set in Montserrat Bold (SIL OFL 1.1, py_modules/button_glyphs/masks/OFL-Montserrat.txt) by tools/qb_build.py
- `owner-pixel-art`: the project owner's own PlayStation pixel art (stated by the owner, 2026-11-24), sliced and fitted to the texture size by tools/sfh_art.py; some labels use the 3x5 pixel font drawn for that tool
- `owner-line-art`: the project owner's own DualSense line drawing (stated by the owner, 2026-11-24), cut out and scaled by tools/qb_controller_art.py
